name: gap-agent-interaction-disabled
about: agent.interactionProfile=disabled，同时 agent.sandboxMode / runtimeContextSurface 给非法值（loadPilotConfig.ts:428-460 警告并回退缺省）：工具清单、系统提示词，以及缺省权限模式下要询问的 write_file 在没有交互通道时的结果（不设 bypass）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  interactionProfile: disabled
  sandboxMode: bogus
  runtimeContextSurface: nowhere
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
